inclusions.text: Air-conditioned transfer to the desert camp
inclusions.source: The transfer to the desert camp is air-conditioned and straightforward.
At the camp, you are welcomed with a drink and given a brief orientation covering the order of activities and any safety instructions for the quad bikes.
